manifest.name: dsh-browser-bridge
manifest.description: Native Edge browser tools for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Antigravity App

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: browser-bridge
      name: dsh-browser-bridge
      config:
        autoStart: true

declared.name: status
declared.description: Inspect the local bridge and connected browser instances. Does not claim a tab.

declared.name: tabs
declared.description: List tabs and ownership. Select an instance explicitly when several are connected.

declared.name: open
declared.description: Open a page in this session’s tab group and claim it. Returns its opaque tab handle.

declared.name: claim
declared.description: Explicitly acquire an existing free tab selected from browser_tabs. Never steals another session’s tab.

declared.name: session_close
declared.description: Release every tab owned by this session. Leaves tabs open; use when browser work is complete.

readme.text:
让 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop 和 Antigravity App** 直接操作日常使用、已经登录的 **Microsoft Edge**。

DSH 通过原生插件调用浏览器工具，Antigravity App 通过 MCP 调用；两端共用本地桥接服务和 Edge 扩展，可读取页面、截图、点击、输入和管理标签页。

**中文** · [English](README.en.md) · [下载 v2.0.3](https://github.com/AshenJyy/browser-bridge/releases/tag/v2.0.3) · [安装说明](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md) · [文档目录](docs/README.md) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)

| 使用入口 | 下载 | 安装方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DSH Desktop | [dsh-browser-bridge-2.0.3.tgz](https://github.com/AshenJyy/browser-bridge/releases/download/v2.0.3/dsh-browser-bridge-2.0.3.tgz) | 在 DSH 插件管理中添加本地包，再重启相关工作配置或服务 |
| Antigravity App | [browser-bridge-antigravity-2.0.3.zip](https://github.com/AshenJyy/browser-bridge/releases/download/v2.0.3/browser-bridge-antigravity-2.0.3.zip) | 解压后运行 `scripts/Install-Antigravity.ps1`，再重启 App |
| Microsoft Edge | 上述 ZIP 内的 `browser-bridge/extension/`，或源码中的 [`extension/`](extension/) | 在 `edge://extensions` 开启开发者模式，加载解压缩的扩展 |

仅使用 DSH 时，也可以从 ZIP 中提取 Edge 扩展，无需安装 Antigravity App 插件。

完成插件和扩展安装后，在解压后的 `browser-bridge` 目录中执行：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\BrowserBridge.ps1 pair
```

将输出的令牌和端口填入 Edge 扩展弹窗。正常只需配对一次；后续调用会按需启动桥接服务。完整步骤、自定义配置和配对故障处理见 [安装说明](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md)。

| 组件 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH Desktop | 0.2.1：rc.3 起至正式版；0.2.2：rc.1 起至正式版，允许后续 rc，无需逐个登记 |
| Node.js | 22+；Windows 脚本优先使用 DSH 自带运行时 |
| Microsoft Edge | 125+，使用已加载 Browser Bridge 扩展的浏览器配置 |
| Antigravity | 支持插件的 Antigravity App |

发布 ZIP 自带 JavaScript 运行文件，使用时无需安装 Python 或 npm 依赖。DSH 直接注册原生工具，无需 agy 或外部子代理。

**发布状态：** v2.0.3 已构建和打包，未运行自动化测试、逐版本验证或双宿主端到端验收。声明的版本范围不等于每个版本都已经验证。

- **读取页面：** 正文、结构化快照、真实标签页截图。
- **操作网页：** 点击、悬停、输入、按键、滚动、下拉选择、导航与等待。
- **处理文件与对话框：** 文件上传、工具发起的下载、JavaScript 对话框。
- **管理标签页：** 列举、新建、明确接管、分组、释放与关闭。

27 个统一 `browser_*` 工具复用现有 Edge 的登录状态。截图以图像工具结果返回，所选模型需要支持图像。每次操作都指定标签句柄，不会默认操作当前活动页面。

DSH 按 Agent/Session 分配标签归属；Antigravity 按 MCP 进程分配。共享同一 MCP 进程的聊天不自动获得独立身份。浏览器内部页和原生系统窗口不在操作范围内，其他限制见 [范围与限制](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md#范围与限制)。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  D[DSH 原生插件] --> B[本地 Browser Bridge]
  A[Antigravity App] --> M[MCP 适配器]
  M --> B

默认监听 `127.0.0.1:9224`。Windows 状态和令牌保存在 `%USERPROFILE%\.browser-bridge`；端口与状态目录可配置。两端使用相同设置即可共享桥接服务。页面内容和截图会交给所用宿主与模型处理。

| 入口 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [文档目录](docs/README.md) | 安装、开发、协议和旧版入口的导航 |
| [开发说明](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) | 源码目录、构建方式与发布包结构 |
| [协议说明](docs/PROTOCOL.md) | HTTP、WebSocket 和会话约定 |
| [旧版启动入口](docs/LEGACY.md) | Python 转发器、手动启动和开机自启脚本的用途 |
| [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) | 各版本的变更 |
| [Issues](https://github.com/AshenJyy/browser-bridge/issues) | 问题反馈与功能建议 |

本项目由原 Antigravity Browser Bridge 重构，采用 [Apache-2.0](LICENSE) 许可，是面向 DSH 与 Antigravity App 的社区插件。

Control your existing, signed-in **Microsoft Edge** tabs from **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** and **Antigravity App**.

DSH registers native browser tools; Antigravity App connects through MCP. Both use the same local bridge and Edge extension for page reading, screenshots, browser actions, and tab management.

[中文](README.md) · **English** · [Download v2.0.3](https://github.com/AshenJyy/browser-bridge/releases/tag/v2.0.3) · [Documentation](docs/README.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

| Host | Package | Installation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DSH Desktop | [dsh-browser-bridge-2.0.3.tgz](https://github.com/AshenJyy/browser-bridge/releases/download/v2.0.3/dsh-browser-bridge-2.0.3.tgz) | Add the local package in DSH plugin management, then restart the relevant profile or service |
| Antigravity App | [browser-bridge-antigravity-2.0.3.zip](https://github.com/AshenJyy/browser-bridge/releases/download/v2.0.3/browser-bridge-antigravity-2.0.3.zip) | Extract, run `scripts/Install-Antigravity.ps1`, and restart the app |
| Microsoft Edge | `browser-bridge/extension/` from the ZIP, or [`extension/`](extension/) from this repository | Enable developer mode at `edge://extensions` and load the unpacked extension |

DSH-only users can extract the Edge extension from the ZIP without installing the Antigravity App plugin. After installing the host plugin and extension, run this command from the extracted `browser-bridge` directory:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\BrowserBridge.ps1 pair
```

Enter the returned token and port in the extension popup. Pairing normally persists across restarts, and tool calls start the bridge on demand. See the [full installation guide in Chinese](docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md) for configuration and pairing recovery.

- **DSH:** `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <=0.2.1 || >=0.2.2-rc.1 <=0.2.2`. This admits subsequent release candidates and the stable release in both version families without listing each version.
- **Node.js:** 22+. Windows scripts prefer the runtime bundled with DSH.
- **Edge:** 125+, with the extension loaded in the browser profile you want to control.
- **Antigravity:** the App with plugin support.

The release ZIP includes bundled JavaScript runtime files. Using it does not require Python or installing npm dependencies. DSH uses native tools directly, without agy or an external subagent.

**Release status:** v2.0.3 has been built and packaged. Automated tests, cross-version verification, and end-to-end host acceptance have not been run.

The 27 `browser_*` tools cover page text, structured snapshots, screenshots, clicks, hovering, typing, keys, scrolling, selection, navigation, waits, uploads, downloads, dialogs, and explicit tab ownership. Screenshot results are images and require a model with image support.

Every operation targets an explicit tab handle. DSH separates ownership by Agent/Session; Antigravity separates it by MCP process. Chats sharing one MCP process do not automatically receive separate identities. Browser internal pages and native system windows are outside the supported scope.

The bridge listens on `127.0.0.1:9224` by default. Windows state and the pairing token live in `%USERPROFILE%\.browser-bridge`. Page contents and screenshots are passed to the selected host and model.

- [Development guide](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md): source layout, build commands, and release packaging; in Chinese.
- [Protocol](docs/PROTOCOL.md): HTTP, WebSocket, and session details; in English.
- [Legacy entry points](docs/LEGACY.md): Python wrappers and optional Windows launchers; in Chinese.
- [Issues](https://github.com/AshenJyy/browser-bridge/issues): bug reports and feature requests.
Browser Bridge evolved from Antigravity Browser Bridge. It is a community plugin, licensed under [Apache-2.0](LICENSE).
